content.short: Novel is a no-code NFT tool that helps merchants build token-gated ecommerce stores.
content.description: Novel is a comprehensive NFT tool that helps NFT holders build no-code eCommerce stores. With Novel, users can set up token-gated stores and NFT collections in minutes, sell NFTs on Shopify, and offer token-gated benefits to customers. Founded in October 2021 by Anna Merzi, Brian Sugar, and Roger Beaman, Novel provides an API that lets developers bring token-gating features to their applications with a single line of code.
content.meta: Novel is a no-code tool for merchants to create token-gated ecommerce stores. Discover Novel and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
